record_notes.DCP-LETT-1975: October15, supplied1856; four blocks and four notes read, no bibliography. Runt actually received this morning. record_notes.DCP-LETT-1976: October19, supplied1856; seven blocks, five notes and bibliography read. Missing Tegetmeier acceptance of cock, Thursday delivery planned. Attributes provenance to Daniell, including smaller Congo fowls and possible another cock access; this revises earlier purity impression. These precise Daniell remarks are absent from1970 and postdate neither November7 nor November14 sources by assumption. Do not backdate a complete multipart incoming letter. record_notes.DCP-LETT-1981: November3, supplied1856; all fifteen blocks, seven notes and bibliography read. Missing note acknowledged; comb differences added. Eaton book in possession, Malay eggs spring preference. Nine Elliot skins already received, list counts2+2+2+1+2 and uncertain Rangoon provenance. Raw diag/ramme are literal markup artifacts across P4–8; no figure/table/MathML. Future loan/return of skins and jungle-fowl head not new receipt. Persian birds expected, Bosquet help promised, Bult sale catalogue received today and unhelpful. Body thanks Finnikin enquiries before later November11 public notice; no assertion already read the future issue. Duck-cross query requested, no printed response located.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1992: November19, supplied1856; six blocks, six notes and bibliography read. Emma health prevents attendance; unidentified December9 paper cannot automatically become actual November25 lecture. New down/colour correlation and confirmation received in missing note, no full text. Two yellow Tumblers killed and lack of matched colours limits own testing. Persian arrival still unknown; heard of extensive West African collection, consistent with1988 P1 but not delivered specimens. First book-number claim repeats contemporary belief later corrected. record_notes.DCP-LETT-2004: November29, supplied1856; four blocks, four notes and bibliography read. Persian common and Lari poultry skins actually received; Natal shipment on route, Gabriel collection still being made. These are distinct acquisition stages; apparatus calls them pigeons while body is poultry, so preserve source mismatch. £4 4s 10d shipment cost has superscript currency labels in raw HTML, not decimal or separate numbers without units. Wallace collecting reported; October10 missing letter not thereby received (2086 says only few days before May1). Offers Tegetmeier scientific description responsibility, conditional on his judgment/time; later reputation forecast is hope.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2011: December4, supplied1856; six blocks, four notes and bibliography read. Rangoon origin unknown and Pariah ordinary form remain limits. Missing note indicates Tegetmeier agreement and rheumatism. Brooke has reported dispatch of Borneo fowls in missing letter; present receipt not established. Natal on route, Persian skins waiting for combined dispatch. Body says sent, whereas summary promises, and later actual receipt must not be backdated. Future Poultry Book descriptions hoped, not yet available to Darwin.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2048: February6, supplied1857; eight blocks, seven notes and bibliography read. Missing valuable note offers eggs/drake and cross information. Rumpless embryo sought about24hours BEFORE hatching; not unhatched egg of unknown development. Black drake collection/payment next Thursday prospective. Carrier from Hayne already in possession. Pheasant/poultry hybrid account valued in incoming note; later annotated publication not proof correct edition already read. P8 says German pouter found this morning, request withdrawn. Footnote refers to deleted postscript but no actual manuscript-alterations section survives on raw page; do not reconstruct deleted wording. record_notes.DCP-LETT-2051: February11, supplied1857; eight blocks and four notes read, no bibliography. Bearer to pay and collect drake; Persian skins to be dispatched tonight for possible show. Silk embryo requested12hours before hatching, separate from rumpless promise. Scanderoon preservation assurance; fancy Wicking pouters supposed crossed because not breeding true, not proven parentage. Brent affairs possibly better, not settled. Later February24 show account is not completed action on February11.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2054: February18, supplied1857; both blocks, three notes and bibliography read. Brooke fowls just received: Chinese-origin white silk, one crested, and Singapore-procured frizzled fowls of unknown origin. Night dispatch to Tegetmeier planned for show. Chinese/unknown origins and Singapore procurement are different fields; do not equate with later interior-Borneo specimens.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2090: May12, supplied month/year from return and later reply; ten blocks, thirteen notes and bibliography read. Dozen rumpless eggs requested to test constancy, not known true. Scanderoon pair not laying; sex uncertain in body, postscript suspects hen ill after fresh observation and servant report. Preserve within-letter changing assessment. Interior-Borneo fowls now received; loan prospective. Mislaid down/colour note asks repetition, actual text missing. Correct book not yet got, only presumed at brother house; modern future observation not substituted. Fowl cross colour and down patterns requested, not outcomes.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2093: May18, supplied1857; eleven blocks, six notes and bibliography read. Seriatim answers missing incoming note; Scanderoons/Borneo skins future Thursday shipment, young Barbs later. Gulliver never sent previously promised bird; runt purchase negotiated. P5 explicitly corrects bookseller error: old edition not apparently Tegetmeier, actual edition still sought. This explains earlier first-number claim without rewriting those letters. Rumpless eggs now put under hen today; no hatch result yet. Offered chicken observations declined for workload; crossed-fowl red absence surprise and magpie/helmet future adult colour still questioned.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2108: Thursday suppliedJune18,1857 at Moor Park; five blocks, six notes and bibliography read. Declines offered cross, approves investigations but no completed tail/down results. Borneo poultry interesting to recipient, inference based missing note. Runt request conditional on dead bird through Bridge, no live specimen taken yet. Old outgoing offers and same-author sequence not prompts.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2110: June23, supplied1857; three blocks, three notes and bibliography read. Three rumpless eggs hatched, two black/one banded; learned two or three days AFTER hatching through communication failure, not exact hatch day. No embryo24hours before birth obtained. Proposes exchange grown birds for embryo, not fulfilled. Moor Park stay untilJune30 future at writing. Historic request not executed instruction.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2111: Thursday25, suppliedJune1857; four blocks, three notes and bibliography read. One embryo when shell chips sufficient, intended shipment to Down and postage enclosed; observation and freezing/killing proposal not actual specimen arrival. Correct published book numbers finally received just before leaving home, soon to study; receipt therefore earlier thanJune25, reading not yet. Wild jungle-fowl skull requested back eventually, not newly delivered. Bridge address asked; no missing note reconstructed.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2115: Sunday suppliedJuly19,1857; nine blocks and six notes read, no bibliography. Gilbert young Runts gift received; declines other young one, Gulliver dead body sought. One of three supposedly rumpless chicks has decided tail, limits breed constancy. Planned six-bird consignment specifies observed juvenile colours and uncertain future colour/sex; P9 corrects Trumpeter sexes to four cocks/one hen, so cannot send, retaining initial P5 uncertainty. Correct Poultry Book still explicitly unread despite earlier receipt. Young Jacobin eye status later assessed, no retroactive certainty.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2128: July27, supplied1857; six blocks, five notes and bibliography read. Thanks two missing notes; learns Jacobins poor, did not inspect eyes, recipient breed names uncertain. Newly accepts Runt offer conditional on mature specimen and own later use, reverses earlier refusal without erasing it. Ghoondook carcass sought only if breeding ended; courier/payment plan not completed delivery.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2146: September29, supplied1857; four blocks, five notes and bibliography read. General decision to cease pigeon collection immediately qualified by current Smiter enquiry; do not export summary as unconditional cessation. Himalayan rabbit skeleton already here, duplicate head desired. Adult Malay still wanted, wild-jungle head return future. Burmese skins reported in Berlin, not yet Darwin possession; later1858 letter in apparatus distinct. Account September12 payment and just-written September29 request remain separate evidence, not invented acquisition date.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2173: November21, supplied1857; seven blocks, six notes and bibliography read. Reconsidered Malay cock offer after catalogue check lacks young chicken comparison; asks spring eggs instead. Pigeons to be given away probably next summer after writing/comparison, not already abandoned. Jacobins killed due poor eyes, news/thanks missing note. Kidney-bean notice liked, no full incoming review. January1858 actual show attendance and manuscript June1858 revision are future apparatus. Catalogue said unlocated here unlike earlier named catalogue; no content reconstructed.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1970: Daniell multipart incoming October8–November7,1856; all nine blocks, seven notes, separate Darwin abstract and bibliography freshly read. P5 explicitly London October20, P8 November7 closure, so whole document cannot be placed at October8 or used as complete October19 input. October8 opening received missing Darwin query; pigeons one local breed, wild fowls believed feral, not proof of evolutionary origin. Dogs/cats reproductive response, poultry data absent and temporary infertility speculation coexist; separate Darwin abstract simplifies them and cannot replace body. Historical complexion/temperament disease claims and king anecdote are attributed claims, not verified modern science. West African island stock/import history, suggested books, depth observations and promised lookup distinct. No source wording for precise Congo colouring or accidental sire account in1976.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-1988: November14,1856; all six blocks, eight notes, complete separate Darwin annotations/note and bibliography freshly read. Received missing Darwin query just now; answers island mammals with Portuguese copied historical passage, not own witnessed census. Gabriel poultry collection being assembled reported via Scourge letter, not delivery. Original Portuguese includes monkeys/rats and introduced livestock; footnote English translation and modern taxon gloss are editorial, excluded from export. P5–6 historical dates/source citation are author body, distinct from undated Darwin queries/marginal reasoning. Darwin annotation hostile case is not independently dated; November15 outgoing1989 explicitly records morning blow on mammals/soundings and apparatus identifies this letter. Known by November15 morning, exact physical delivery not independently stated. Later1992/2004 collection references corroborate distinct paragraph without replacing earliest bound.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
